title: Algebraizing a formal coherent module that is algebraizable on the thickenings V(K^e) and comparable to a completion up to K-power torsion
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme (a locally Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth] with quasi-compact underlying space) and $\mathcal I,\mathcal K\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ quasi-coherent sheaves of ideals; powers and products $\mathcal K^e$, $\mathcal K^t(\mathcal F_n)$ are as in [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module] (0),(3). For $e\ge1$ let $i_e:X_e\to X$ be the closed subscheme cut out by $\mathcal K^e$ [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-ideal-closed-subscheme] (a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion] with ideal sheaf $\mathcal K^e$ [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf]) and $\mathcal I_e=\mathcal I\mathcal O_{X_e}$ the image of $i_e^*\mathcal I\to\mathcal O_{X_e}$ [def-nagata-extended-ideal]. Let $(\mathcal F_n)$ be an object of $\mathit{Coh}(X,\mathcal I)$ [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module]. Assume (1) for every $e\ge1$ the completion functor $\mathit{Coh}(\mathcal O_{X_e})\to\mathit{Coh}(X_e,\mathcal I_e)$, $\mathcal G\mapsto\mathcal G^\wedge$, is an equivalence of categories; and (2) there are a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal H$ [pqf-def-coherent], a morphism $\alpha:(\mathcal F_n)\to\mathcal H^\wedge$ of $\mathit{Coh}(X,\mathcal I)$ and an integer $t\ge1$ such that the kernel and the cokernel of $\alpha$, taken in the abelian category $\mathit{Coh}(X,\mathcal I)$ [lem-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-modules-abelian], are annihilated by $\mathcal K^t$ (equivalently, by [lem-weil-pbc-formal-systems-annihilated-by-power], $\alpha$ is a map whose kernel and cokernel are annihilated by a power of $\mathcal K$ in the sense of Stacks Remark 0888). Then $(\mathcal F_n)$ is in the essential image of the completion functor $\mathit{Coh}(\mathcal O_X)\to\mathit{Coh}(X,\mathcal I)$: there are a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal F$ and an isomorphism $\mathcal F^\wedge\cong(\mathcal F_n)$ in $\mathit{Coh}(X,\mathcal I)$.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 088A (lemma-existence-tricky, line 6940), Section 0886 (section-existence-proper); its proof uses Lemma 087T (lemma-i-star-equivalence), Remark 0888 (remark-inverse-systems-kernel-cokernel-annihilated-by) and Lemma 0889 (lemma-existence-easy)

proof.text: For each e >= 1, the closed immersion i_e : X_e -> X has ideal K^e. By [lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-coherent-equivalence], coherent modules on X_e identify with coherent O_X-modules annihilated by K^e, and the corresponding formal systems identify with the full subcategory of Coh(X,I) annihilated by K^e. Under this identification, hypothesis (1) says that the completion functor gives an equivalence between these two categories.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 088A, proof lines 6961--6968; Lemma 087T

proof.text: Apply that equivalence to the quotient system (F_n / K^e F_n)_n to obtain a coherent O_X-module G_e annihilated by K^e, together with its identification with the quotient formal system. The quotient maps for e+1 -> e correspond to maps G_{e+1} -> G_e inducing isomorphisms G_{e+1}/K^e G_{e+1} = G_e. Thus (G_e)_e is an object of Coh(X,K).

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 088A, proof lines 6969--6977

proof.text: The map alpha : (F_n) -> H^ induces maps F_n/K^e F_n -> H/(I^n + K^e)H, hence, through the same equivalence, maps G_e -> H/K^e H. Choose t >= 1 annihilating the kernels and cokernels of the component maps of alpha. The commutative-algebra assertion in [lem-weil-pbc-formal-systems-annihilated-by-power] first gives a K^(2t) bound after quotienting by K^e, and applying the same assertion to the induced map of the K-adic systems gives a K^(4t) bound for the kernels and cokernels of G_e -> H/K^e H.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 088A, proof lines 6978--6993; Remark 0888

proof.text: The maps G_e -> H/K^e H therefore satisfy the hypotheses of [lem-weil-pbc-grothendieck-existence-easy], part (1), with ideal K. We obtain a coherent O_X-module F, a map a:F -> H whose kernel and cokernel are killed by a power of K, and an isomorphism beta:(G_e) = (F/K^e F)_e compatible with a.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 088A, proof lines 6994--6997; Lemma 0889

proof.text: Fix n. Reduce alpha_n and the comparison beta modulo I^n. The resulting map from F_n/K^e F_n to H/(I^n + K^e)H and the corresponding map from F/I^n F form a triple to which the uniqueness clause of [lem-weil-pbc-grothendieck-existence-easy] applies. It gives an isomorphism F/I^n F = F_n; uniqueness makes these isomorphisms compatible with all transition maps. Hence F^ is isomorphic to (F_n) in Coh(X,I).

lean.statement: theorem grothendieck_existence_devissage {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] (I K : X.IdealSheafData) (M : CoherentFormalModule X I) (hthick : ∀ (e : ℕ), 1 ≤ e → ∀ (hZ : IsNoetherian (K ^ e).subscheme), Functor.IsEquivalence (@completion ((K ^ e).subscheme) hZ (I.comap (K ^ e).subschemeι))) (H : CoherentModules X) (α : M ⟶ completion X I |>.obj H) (htorsion : ∃ t : ℕ, 1 ≤ t ∧ ∃ k : KernelFork α, ∃ c : CokernelCofork α, Nonempty (IsLimit k) ∧ Nonempty (IsColimit c) ∧ (∀ n : ℕ, IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower K.toModulesι t).2 (k.pt.obj.obj (op n)))) ∧ (∀ n : ℕ, IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower K.toModulesι t).2 (c.pt.obj.obj (op n))))) : ∃ F : CoherentModules X, Nonempty ((completion X I).obj F ≅ M)
